scope: method/code only; no AVT dataset training, remote execution or automated follow-up
architecture: deterministic support/log-radius predictor; original four bounded branches; shared segmentation/Gaussian heads
attribute_loss: case-equal occupancy Dice+BCE and measured log-radius MSE; no fabricated unknown-radius labels
joint_base: P pretraining then joint P/S with main Dice+BCE, DS .5/.25, attribute auxiliary .1
handoff: selected mature-base P/S is indivisible; descendants never reload the earlier predictor
condition: no GDF; alpha ramp250; local shared1e-4/gates1e-3
head_prewarm: after conditional adaptation; same parent arm and alpha1; only Gaussian head learns
geometry: GDF .1 to1 over5000 updates; alpha1 and learned conditions retained
refine: GDF1 to.2 over5000; local learning rates halved; main Dice+BCE weight unchanged
sampling: TRAIN case-equal then six phase-specific anchor sources; bounded candidates and explicit fallbacks
sampling_counts: requested/actual/fallback source plus actual valid-voxel foreground fraction; anchor mix is not voxel ratio
validation: fixed common VAL patch sampling; native Dice first, connectivity metrics separate; no label-driven inference
execution: default stop_after=base; complete explicit; one variant only, no automatic factorial sweep
configuration_source: configs/phases.json; all resolved phase recipes included in resume identity
evidence: no new efficacy claim; long defaults and higher Gaussian weight are not validated optimum
